path.title: DevOps Engineer Path
path.summary: Learn platform engineering through Linux, Git, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability — inspired by Boot.dev and adapted for local hands-on labs.
path.source: Structure inspired by Boot.dev DevOps path; extended with 90DaysOfDevOps topics and FinTech platform roadmap (Proxmox, PostgreSQL, Kafka).

phases.title: Phase 1 — Foundations
phases.summary: Terminal fluency, Git recovery, and the DevOps feedback loop.

modules.title: Learn Linux
modules.summary: Command line, filesystems, permissions, and pipelines.

labs.title: Linux Shell and File Basics
labs.summary: Practice core terminal skills—navigation, file creation, and output redirection—in an isolated environment.

labs.title: Linux Navigation and Permissions
labs.summary: Repair a deployment workspace using paths, ownership, modes, and pipelines.

labs.title: Log Pipelines and Redirection
labs.summary: Use pipes, redirection, and filters to turn noisy application logs into an actionable incident summary.

labs.title: Filesystem Discovery
labs.summary: Find large files and document disk usage patterns before a node runs out of space.

modules.title: Terminal Mastery
modules.summary: Persistent sessions and fast edits on bastion hosts.

labs.title: Survive with Tmux Sessions
labs.summary: Create a persistent tmux layout with named windows and a reusable config for platform work.

labs.title: Edit Faster with Neovim Basics
labs.summary: Create a minimal Neovim config and use it to fix a broken service unit file from the terminal.

modules.title: 90Days Topic Bridges
modules.summary: Scenario rewrites from 90DaysOfDevOps with PlatformForge validators.

labs.title: Automate a Backup with Bash
labs.summary: Write a small shell script that archives a directory and records a success marker — a 90Days-style automation drill.

labs.title: Pin and Tag Container Images
labs.summary: Replace floating tags with a pinned image reference and document a release tag naming convention.

labs.title: Author a First Kubernetes Manifest
labs.summary: Write a valid Deployment YAML for a simple web workload using 90Days Kubernetes fundamentals.

labs.title: Trace a Service Connection Path
labs.summary: Map hostname, port, and health URL for a payments API using 90Days-style networking fundamentals.

labs.title: Build a Tiny Uptime Check
labs.summary: Turn raw probe results into an up/down status file — a 90Days monitoring fundamentals drill.

labs.title: Tag Cloud Resources for Cost and Ownership
labs.summary: Apply required tags to a resource inventory so cost and ownership are auditable — a 90Days cloud fundamentals drill.

labs.title: Keep Secrets Out of Git
labs.summary: Move a leaked token into an ignored secrets file and document the rotation follow-up — a 90Days security fundamentals drill.

modules.title: Datacenter Networking Tickets
modules.summary: VLAN, gateway, ACL, NAT, and traceroute drills using PatchLab-style tip codes.
modules.source: Pedagogy inspired by cozyGarage/patchlab (CCNA/datacenter rack trainer)

labs.title: Fix a VLAN Access Mismatch
labs.summary: Ticket drill inspired by PatchLab: move a server onto the correct access VLAN without breaking documentation.

labs.title: Reach the WAN via Default Gateway
labs.summary: Ticket drill inspired by PatchLab: fix host addressing and default gateway so off-subnet ping succeeds.

labs.title: Order Firewall ACLs Correctly
labs.summary: Ticket drill inspired by PatchLab: insert a host deny above a broad permit so one client is blocked and others pass.

labs.title: Publish a Host with Static NAT
labs.summary: Ticket drill inspired by PatchLab: map an internal payments host to a public address and permit inbound WAN access.

labs.title: Repair a Broken Traceroute Path
labs.summary: Ticket drill inspired by PatchLab: fix a missing static route so traceroute from LAN to ISP completes.

modules.title: Networking Sandbox
modules.summary: Free-play ticket unlocked after the first three networking labs.

labs.title: Networking Sandbox — Free Play Ticket
labs.summary: Unlocked after the first three networking tickets: design a small LAN with VLAN, gateway, ACL, and a path status of your choosing.

modules.title: Learn Git
modules.summary: History recovery, branching, remotes, and safe collaboration.

labs.title: Recover a Broken Git Release
labs.summary: Use Git history and the index to restore a deleted production configuration.

labs.title: Branch and Merge Safely
labs.summary: Create a feature branch, commit a fix, and merge back to main without rewriting shared history.

labs.title: Rebase and Reset Without Panic
labs.summary: Squash noisy commits with interactive rebase and recover from a bad commit using reset.

labs.title: Connect and Push to a Remote
labs.summary: Add a remote repository, push main with upstream tracking, and verify the remote has your commits.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Containers & Networking
phases.summary: Debug images, compose multi-container apps, and reason about connectivity.

modules.title: Learn Docker
modules.summary: Dockerfiles, debugging, and Compose networking.

labs.title: Debug a Container Image
labs.summary: Diagnose a broken image definition and produce a safe, reproducible container specification.

labs.title: Repair Service Networking
labs.summary: Fix a Compose topology so an API uses service discovery instead of loopback.

labs.title: Persist Data with Volumes
labs.summary: Fix a Compose file so application data survives container restarts using named volumes.

phases.title: Phase 2c — Infrastructure as Code
phases.summary: Local Terraform and Ansible planning drills for modules, state, and config management.

modules.title: Learn Terraform
modules.summary: Root modules, reusable network modules, and remote state backends.

labs.title: Author a Terraform Root Module
labs.summary: Write a pinned Terraform root module with locals and an output for a payments app label.

labs.title: Split a Terraform Network Module
labs.summary: Extract a reusable network module with a variable and output, then call it from the root module.

labs.title: Configure a Remote State Backend
labs.summary: Author a partial backend config for S3-style remote state with locking and encryption called out in a runbook.

modules.title: Learn Ansible
modules.summary: Inventories, playbooks with handlers, and idempotency planning for platform hosts.

labs.title: Build an Ansible Inventory
labs.summary: Author a static inventory grouping bastion and payments hosts with a shared deploy group.

labs.title: Write a Hardening Playbook
labs.summary: Author a playbook that targets the deploy group, becomes root, and installs nginx with a handler notify.

labs.title: Prove Handler Idempotency
labs.summary: Document why unchanged packages skip handlers, and add a check mode note for safe dry-runs.

phases.title: Phase 2b — Application Development
phases.summary: Build small HTTP services in Go and Python, plus SQL query drills.

modules.title: Learn HTTP Servers & Go
modules.summary: Health endpoints, JSON handlers, and go test.
modules.source: Boot.dev — Learn HTTP Servers / Learn Go

labs.title: Serve a Go Health Endpoint
labs.summary: Write a tiny Go HTTP server that listens on :8080 and answers /health with ok.

labs.title: Build a Tiny JSON API in Go
labs.summary: Extend HTTP skills with a /payments endpoint that returns JSON and a content-type header.

labs.title: Prove Behavior with Go Tests
labs.summary: Extract a pure function and add a failing-then-passing unit test for payment fee calculation.

modules.title: Learn Python & SQL
modules.summary: Python HTTP services, packaging, SQLite fundamentals, and advanced query/async drills.

labs.title: Serve a Python Health Endpoint
labs.summary: Write a tiny Python HTTP server that listens on :8080 and answers /health with ok.

labs.title: Build a Python JSON API
labs.summary: Add a /payments JSON endpoint beside /health using Python's http.server.

labs.title: Build an Async Python Service
labs.summary: Use asyncio with Python's standard library to serve health and payment responses concurrently.

labs.title: Package a Python Module
labs.summary: Turn fee logic into an importable package with pyproject metadata and a passing unit test.

labs.title: Query Payments with SQL
labs.summary: Load a SQLite ledger and write queries that answer balance and high-value payment questions.

labs.title: Join Accounts and Payments
labs.summary: Use SQL joins to answer who paid what across normalized ledger tables.

labs.title: Speed Queries with Indexes
labs.summary: Add an index for account lookups and capture EXPLAIN output proving SQLite can use it.

labs.title: Rank Payments with Window Functions
labs.summary: Use SQLite window functions to rank payments and calculate running totals by account.

phases.title: Phase 3 — Kubernetes
phases.summary: Deploy reliable workloads on live k3d clusters, then practice CKA-style controls, admission policy, and Gateway API planning.

modules.title: Learn Kubernetes
modules.summary: Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, scaling, and namespaces with kubectl.

labs.title: Deploy a Reliable Workload to Kubernetes
labs.summary: Fix a broken Deployment manifest, apply it to a live k3d cluster, and verify probes and resource limits.

labs.title: Expose a Deployment with a Service
labs.summary: Create a ClusterIP Service so other workloads can reach your API Deployment inside k3d.

labs.title: Inject Configuration with ConfigMaps
labs.summary: Mount a ConfigMap as environment variables for a Deployment running in k3d.

labs.title: Scale a Deployment Horizontally
labs.summary: Increase replica count and verify all pods become ready in your k3d cluster.

labs.title: Isolate Workloads with Namespaces
labs.summary: Create a dedicated namespace, deploy an app into it, and verify resources are scoped correctly.

modules.title: CKA-Style Scenarios
modules.summary: NetworkPolicy, RBAC, troubleshooting, Ingress, storage, backup/restore, and etcd runbooks.

labs.title: Restrict Pod Traffic with NetworkPolicy
labs.summary: Author a default-deny Ingress policy and an allow rule so only the frontend can reach the API.

labs.title: Grant Least-Privilege RBAC
labs.summary: Create a ServiceAccount, Role, and RoleBinding so a deployer can manage Deployments only in the payments namespace.

labs.title: Troubleshoot a Broken Release
labs.summary: Fix ImagePullBackOff and an empty Service selector so the api workload becomes Ready and has Endpoints.

labs.title: Route External Traffic with Ingress
labs.summary: Expose the api Service through an Ingress host rule and confirm the object is programmed in the cluster.

labs.title: Persist Data with PVC and Volume Mounts
labs.summary: Create a PersistentVolumeClaim and mount it into the api Deployment at /data.

labs.title: Backup and Restore Cluster Objects
labs.summary: Snapshot critical manifests, simulate an accidental delete, and restore the payments ConfigMap from backup.

labs.title: Practice etcd Snapshot Runbooks
labs.summary: Author a control-plane backup runbook and produce a verifiable snapshot artifact for disaster recovery drills.

modules.title: Policy as Code
modules.summary: Kyverno baselines and OPA/Gatekeeper constraints for labels, digests, and cost centers.

labs.title: Plan Kyverno Baseline Policies
labs.summary: Author Kyverno ClusterPolicy sketches that require app labels and block :latest images for payments workloads.

labs.title: Plan OPA Gatekeeper Constraints
labs.summary: Sketch a ConstraintTemplate plus Constraint that requires a cost-center label, and document Audit vs Deny modes.

modules.title: Gateway API
modules.summary: Replace Ingress with Gateway/HTTPRoute sketches and weighted canary splits.

labs.title: Plan a Gateway API HTTPRoute
labs.summary: Sketch GatewayClass, Gateway, and HTTPRoute objects that expose payments-api on api.payments.example.

labs.title: Plan Gateway Canary Traffic Splits
labs.summary: Design an HTTPRoute weight split between stable and canary Services, plus a rollback checklist.

comingSoon: Live Gateway API apply on k3d (runtime)

phases.title: Phase 4 — Delivery & Reliability
phases.summary: CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Helm, secrets ops, observability, SLOs, and incident response.

modules.title: Learn CI/CD
modules.summary: Fix broken pipelines, add security gates, and ship safely.

labs.title: Fix a Broken CI Pipeline
labs.summary: Repair a GitHub Actions workflow missing test and lint stages before deploy.

labs.title: Add a Supply Chain Security Gate
labs.summary: Stop a leaked secret from shipping and require a vulnerability scan job before deploy.

modules.title: Learn GitOps
modules.summary: Declarative desired state, drift reconcile loops, and Kustomize overlay promotion.

labs.title: Plan a GitOps Manifest Sync Loop
labs.summary: Capture desired state in Git, detect cluster drift, and describe a reconcile loop that treats Git as source of truth.

labs.title: Plan Kustomize Overlay Promotions
labs.summary: Sketch a base plus overlay layout, promote digests upward across envs, and call out overlay drift risks.

modules.title: Learn Helm
modules.summary: Chart skeletons, values overrides, and digest-friendly env promotion.

labs.title: Author a Helm Chart Skeleton
labs.summary: Build Chart.yaml, values.yaml, and a Deployment template with standard Helm placeholders for payments-web.

labs.title: Plan Helm Values Overrides
labs.summary: Separate shared chart defaults from env values files and document a safe --set vs -f override policy.

modules.title: Secrets Operations
modules.summary: External Secrets Operator planning and credential rotation runbooks.

labs.title: Plan External Secrets Sync
labs.summary: Design an ExternalSecret that syncs from a vault-backed SecretStore without committing plaintext credentials.

labs.title: Write a Secrets Rotation Runbook
labs.summary: Author a rotation runbook covering detect leak, rotate backend secret, refresh ExternalSecret, and verify consumers.

modules.title: Logging & Observability
modules.summary: Structured logs, metrics, alerts, and on-call debugging.

labs.title: Parse Structured Logs
labs.summary: Query JSON log lines to find failing requests and produce an on-call summary file.

labs.title: Turn Metrics into an Alert
labs.summary: Compute an HTTP error rate from Prometheus-style metrics and author a threshold alert plus on-call note.

modules.title: Reliability & On-Call
modules.summary: SLOs, error budgets, burn-rate alerts, chaos experiments, game days, and shift handoffs.

labs.title: Define an Availability SLO
labs.summary: Turn success/total request counts into an SLI ratio, pick a 99.9% SLO target, and document a 30-day measurement window for payments-api.

labs.title: Write an Error Budget Policy
labs.summary: Calculate remaining error budget from an SLO burn and document freeze, slow-roll, and page gates for payments-api.

labs.title: Design Multi-Window Burn Alerts
labs.summary: Sketch fast and slow burn-rate alerts for a 99.9% SLO and leave an on-call note that points to rollback.

labs.title: Plan a Chaos Experiment
labs.summary: Write a payments-api chaos experiment with hypothesis, blast radius, abort criteria, and a single safe failure mode.

labs.title: Run a Budget-Aware Game Day
labs.summary: Facilitate a payments game day with roles, freeze gate, success criteria, and a post-game learning note tied to error budget.

labs.title: Write an On-Call Handoff
labs.summary: Produce a shift handoff with severity ladder, open pages, error-budget status, and escalation contacts for payments-api.

modules.title: Capstone Projects
modules.summary: Multi-skill incidents spanning reliability, compliance, and platform design.

labs.title: Capstone — Restore the Checkout Platform
labs.summary: Triage a multi-layer release failure and leave an auditable incident record.

labs.title: Capstone — Stabilize Payments Reliability
labs.summary: Restore a broken checkout release, reconcile the ledger, add an alert, and leave an auditable incident record.

labs.title: Capstone — Ship a Compliant Data Release
labs.summary: Mask a customer export, produce DORA evidence, write an audit pack, and scope a least-privilege IAM role before release.

labs.title: Capstone — Design a Platform Landing Zone
labs.summary: Produce a local FinTech landing-zone pack: least-privilege IAM, secure S3, VPC plan, Kubernetes baseline, and a rollback runbook.

labs.title: Capstone — Ship a GitOps Delivery Pack
labs.summary: Assemble a payments-web delivery pack: Helm chart with prod digest values, GitOps sync policy, ExternalSecret without plaintext, and a rotation verify runbook — then commit clean.

labs.title: Capstone — Reliability Game Day
labs.summary: Run a payments-api reliability drill: record SLO burn and freeze, execute a chaos experiment with abort, write a blameless postmortem, and commit the evidence pack.

labs.title: Capstone — Platform Product Pack
labs.summary: Assemble a platform-product pack: golden-path template + scorecard, FinOps labels/budget, multi-env promotion ADR, and a clean commit.

modules.title: Leadership Capstones
modules.summary: Capture decisions and run blameless learning reviews.

labs.title: Write an Architecture Decision Record
labs.summary: Capture a durable ADR for choosing Kubernetes Ingress over NodePort for the payments API edge.

labs.title: Run a Blameless Postmortem
labs.summary: Turn raw incident notes into a blameless postmortem with timeline, root cause, and action items.

modules.title: Portfolio Project
modules.summary: Stitch HTTP, Docker, and Kubernetes into a public demo path.

labs.title: Portfolio — Payments API Service
labs.summary: Ship a demo-ready Go payments service with /health, /payments, and a project README.

labs.title: Portfolio — Containerize the API
labs.summary: Package the payments API in a reproducible Dockerfile with a non-root user and pinned base image.

labs.title: Portfolio — Ship to Kubernetes
labs.summary: Deploy the payments API with Deployment, Service, and Ingress on a live k3d cluster.

labs.title: Portfolio — Public Demo Writeup
labs.summary: Write the DEMO.md hiring managers read — architecture, runbook, and evidence of the full path.

phases.title: Phase 5 — Platform Engineering
phases.summary: Platform product skills, data, compliance, bare-metal, and local AWS mental models from the FinTech architect roadmap.

modules.title: Platform Product Skills
modules.summary: IDP golden paths, FinOps guardrails, and multi-env promotion ADRs.

labs.title: Plan an IDP Golden Path
labs.summary: Sketch a paved-road service template, scorecard gates, and self-service checklist for payments teams.

labs.title: Plan FinOps Cost Guardrails
labs.summary: Define required cost labels, a monthly budget alert, and a rightsizing note for payments-api workloads.

labs.title: ADR — Multi-Env Promotion Path
labs.summary: Record an ADR choosing digest-pinned Helm values promotion via GitOps over imperative kubectl per environment.

labs.title: Point-in-Time Recovery Drill
labs.summary: Reconstruct a payments table to a recovery target by replaying a base backup and WAL segments, stopping before the bad change.

labs.title: Capture Database Changes with CDC
labs.summary: Configure a Debezium-style connector and materialize change events into a sink table file.

labs.title: Plan Redis HA Failover
labs.summary: Document a payments Redis primary/replica topology, failover trigger, and client cutover checklist without data-loss windows.

labs.title: Mask PII Before Export
labs.summary: Redact personal data from a customer export so the file is safe to share with vendors.

labs.title: Produce DORA Evidence from Deploy Logs
labs.summary: Calculate deployment frequency and change-fail rate from release and incident records for an audit folder.

labs.title: Close Basic PCI-DSS Gaps
labs.summary: Fix a checkout config that logs full card data, uses HTTP, and stores PAN on disk.

labs.title: Assemble SOC 2 Change Evidence
labs.summary: Build a change-evidence pack with ticket link, approval, diff summary, and post-deploy verification for a payments release.

labs.title: Plan a Proxmox Homelab Platform
labs.summary: Turn a blank inventory into a concrete Proxmox node and VM placement plan for a FinTech lab.

labs.title: Establish a Debian Platform Baseline
labs.summary: Harden a host baseline by disabling root SSH passwords, pinning critical packages, and recording the standard.

labs.title: Plan Rack Power and Capacity
labs.summary: Size a payments edge rack for power budget, network uplinks, and growth headroom before ordering hardware.

modules.title: AWS Local Simulations
modules.summary: IAM, S3, and VPC design drills without a cloud account.

labs.title: Model Least-Privilege IAM
labs.summary: Author an IAM policy that allows S3 read on one bucket and deny everything else for a deployer role.

labs.title: Design a Private Artifact Bucket
labs.summary: Configure a private S3 bucket policy and lifecycle rules for CI artifacts without public access.

labs.title: Sketch a Three-Tier VPC
labs.summary: Define public/private subnet layout, NAT placement, and security group rules for a payments API.
